tour.resumeFresh: The Guided Tour couldn’t pick up where it stopped, so your layout is back as it was and the tour starts from the beginning.
tour.resumeFreshLost: The Guided Tour couldn’t pick up where it stopped, so it starts from the beginning. Your layout from before it couldn’t be put back; Settings › Window & panels › Reset Home layout puts the panels back in their default places.
